note_attrition: UNKNOWN attrition can make eligible runs < 5 per vendor; per-vendor r_v uses eligible runs; zero-eligible vendors are indeterminate (reported, not scored 0); no top-up / no optional stopping
runs_per_vendor_rationale: inference is vendor-level; precision comes from N; k=5 gives per-vendor rates in {0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1} and a usable within-vendor variance; >5 wastes budget, <3 cannot separate flaky from hard

tool_version_pinning.mid_cohort_version_change: halts and is recorded, never silently mixed

model.drift_or_identity_change: halts comparison for affected runs (counted, excluded)
model.secondary_model_arm: optional pre-registered sensitivity only; analysed separately; never pooled into P_v

settings.temperature: low/deterministic where supported (frozen exact value at prereg)

one_sandbox_account_per_vendor_allowed_i: nonce + temporal boundary make runs independently verifiable
no run observes another run's objects as its own
account_isolation.else: provision k isolated sub-accounts OR mark vendor INELIGIBLE_PRE_EXECUTION and replace

stopping_rule: run the full frozen N x k attempts regardless of interim rates; NO early stop for favourable or unfavourable results; halts occur ONLY for safety or apparatus faults, are recorded, and are reported; never stop for outcome
cheapest_defensible: ~24x5 runs, one frozen model, sandbox reversible effects, one account per vendor where safe, evidence captured once/run, no pilots folded in, no optional stopping
